This scene:
古代的时候，一个男孩子跟他的妈妈住在中国。他叫孟子。他们住在墓地的旁边，所以孟子老是祭拜。孟子不是祭拜，就是跟朋友聊天。他很喜欢他的城市，但是城市有才两个学校，都很小。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的时候：在古代
- 但是城市有才两个学校：这个城市，只有

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，古代 already refers to a historical time period, so adding 的时候 is redundant.
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 城市有才两个学校：城市里只有两所学校，use 只有 rather than 才有 to mean “there are only”; schools also take the measure word 所.
3. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子不是祭拜，就是跟朋友聊天：他不是祭拜，就是跟朋友聊天，after 孟子 was named in the immediately preceding sentence and no other male character competes as the referent, use a pronoun for close re-occurrence.
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 他的城市：自己的城市，when the possessor is the same person as the subject, use 自己的 to make the relationship clear.

items.reason: 古代 already denotes a time period, so 古代的时候 is redundantly formed under the teacher's rule.
才有 is not the required 只有 structure here, and schools require the measure word 所.
孟子 was just mentioned and there is no competing male referent, so the teacher's close re-occurrence rule requires 他.
他的城市 is grammatical and clear here; 自己的城市 is possible but not required.
